Class BotLiveServiceGrpc.BotLiveServiceStub

com.soulfiremc.grpc.generated.BotLiveServiceGrpc.BotLiveServiceStub
Enclosing class:
BotLiveServiceGrpc
public static final class BotLiveServiceGrpc.BotLiveServiceStub extends io.grpc.stub.AbstractAsyncStub<BotLiveServiceGrpc.BotLiveServiceStub>
A stub to allow clients to do asynchronous rpc calls to service BotLiveService. 
Live bot remote-control service. See file header for scope and design notes.
Permissions:
- READ_BOT_INFO: required for WatchBotEvents, GetBlock, FindBlocks,
                 ListNearbyEntities.
- CONTROL_BOT_ACTIONS: required for chat, interactions, pathfinding, and
                       exclusive control leases.
Error handling mirrors BotService:
- NOT_FOUND: instance or bot does not exist.
- FAILED_PRECONDITION: bot is not online, target not loaded, or the
                       requested action is not currently valid.
- OUT_OF_RANGE: target is outside the bot's reach / observation radius.
- INTERNAL: unexpected server errors.

    • watchBotEvents

      public void watchBotEvents(WatchBotEventsRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<BotEvent> responseObserver)
      Subscribes to a single multiplexed event stream for one bot. The first
message is always the current BotStatus. The stream remains open while the
bot is stopped and follows the configured bot across reconnects. Live
snapshots and filtered events begin whenever a connection becomes ready.

      public void digBlock(DigBlockRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<DigBlockResponse> responseObserver)
      Starts (or stops, when `cancel` is set) breaking a block at a specific
position. Unlike MouseClick, the target is explicit, with no raytrace from
the current look direction is performed.

    • goTo

      public void goTo(GoToRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<PathfindProgress> responseObserver)
      Requests the bot to pathfind to a goal. Returns a stream of progress
events terminating with COMPLETED, FAILED, or CANCELLED. A new GoTo for
the same bot supersedes any in-progress pathfinding; the previous stream
is closed with CANCELLED.
